costs.rounding: aggregate each fee type by account and session, round up to cents
costs.basis: Alpaca October 12, 2026 published standard schedule applied as a constant-fee scenario to every historical date. This is not a reconstruction of historical fees or a confirmation of this account's fee classification.

selection: Two fixed hypotheses. No parameter search, winner selection or rule changes after returns. Phase results reset capital; continuous results are separate. Stress costs do not reselect trades using future returns.
earningsDataPolicy: Use FMP earnings rows requested with includeReportTimes and provider-labelled bmo or amc only to identify the reaction session; do not infer a time for missing or other labels. Enter after the first complete reaction session. Historical consensus revision snapshots remain unverified, so earnings results are retrospective diagnostics only. Never infer point-in-time estimates from lastUpdated.
limitations: Current common-stock catalog excludes delisted companies and is survivorship biased.
Published reference used 2016 through 2023, a different database, both directions and up to four times leverage. Our long-only cash variant is not a full replication or a reproduction of its returns.
Relative opening volumes use split-adjusted volume consistently; trade prices are raw nominal prices. Ambiguous split scales are excluded and disclosed before returns.
Five years include dates inspected by earlier experiments; chronological phases are retrospective, not a pristine holdout.
Historical AAOIFI eligibility is unavailable. These are price and event research diagnostics, not validated halal portfolios.
One-minute OHLC execution cannot establish quote spreads, queue priority, partial fills or exact stop-market executions. Missing held bars and ambiguous entry bars are reported.
Sale proceeds settle after two sessions before May 28, 2024 and after one session thereafter. Remaining settled cash may fund another purchase immediately.
No research module can activate a strategy or place orders.
